---
name: turkish-description-method
description: Ensures that every generated method includes a short and clear Turkish comment explaining what the
method does.
---
When generating code, always follow this process:

1. Every time you create a new method, add a short Turkish comment directly above the method signature
2. The comment must:
- Be written in Turkish
- Be no longer than 1-2 sentences
- Clearly explain what the method does , not how it does it
3. Use clear, simple, and technical Turkish language without unnecessary wording
4. The comment style must match the programming language:
- C# / Java / JavaScript / TypeScript: // or ///
- Python: #
- 5. This rule applies to all newly added or modified methods
6. No method should exist without a Turkishdescriptive comment above it
